input: # The options that change what resolves and how a site's value is built:
# xref writes the reference as written beside every string $ref, resolved
# or not; siblings merge lays a site's members over its target, the site's
# winning, in any version; slots all resolves a $ref in data too, so an
# example that names its own schema closes a cycle; extensions resolves
# inside the named extensions only; targets object leaves a reference to a
# string or a list as written.
